get_daily_forecast.description: Get the weather forecast for one place for the next five days: the weather in words, lowest and highest temperature, chance and strength of rain, and the wind's direction and strength.

mock_response.summary: 5-day forecast for Lisboa. 2026-11-02: Clear sky, 14.1 to 25.9 °C, 0% chance of rain.

get_daily_forecast.name: get_daily_forecast

parameters.description: The place to forecast. Pick it from the list, or give its name (e.g. Lisboa) or IPMA id (e.g. 1110600).
parameters.name: location

count.description: How many days are listed, usually 5.

days.description: One forecast per day, from today.

date.description: The day the forecast is for (YYYY-MM-DD).

rain_intensity.description: How heavy the rain will be: No rain, Light, Moderate or Heavy. Null when IPMA doesn't say.

rain_probability_percent.description: The chance of rain, from 0 to 100.

weather.description: The weather expected, in words, e.g. 'Partly cloudy'.

wind_direction.description: Where the wind mostly comes from: N, NE, E and so on.

wind_direction_name.description: The wind direction in words, e.g. 'Northwest'.

wind_strength.description: How strong the wind will be: Light, Moderate, Strong or Very strong.

location_id.description: IPMA's id for the place, e.g. '1110600' for Lisboa.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

summary.description: One line with the place and the first day's forecast.

updated_at.description: When IPMA last updated this forecast (ISO 8601, UTC).

get_earthquakes.description: Get the earthquakes IPMA recorded in the last 30 days in mainland Portugal, Madeira or the Azores, newest first: time, magnitude, depth, place and whether and where people felt it.

mock_response.summary: 3 earthquakes in the Azores in the last 30 days; the strongest, magnitude 5.3, near Fossa de Hirondelle at 2026-10-20T18:07:19Z.

get_earthquakes.name: get_earthquakes

parameters.description: Where to look. Mainland Portugal includes the sea and border areas around it. Defaults to mainland Portugal.
parameters.name: area

parameters.description: Only earthquakes of at least this magnitude, e.g. 3. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: minimum_magnitude

parameters.description: Only earthquakes people reported feeling.
parameters.name: felt_only

parameters.description: The most earthquakes to list, newest first, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

area.description: The area searched: Mainland Portugal, Madeira or Azores.

count.description: How many are listed here, at most the number asked for.

depth_km.description: How deep it was, in km.

event_id.description: IPMA's id for the earthquake, when it gives one (null for many small ones).

felt.description: True when people reported feeling it.

felt_at.description: Where it was felt most, when it was felt.

intensity.description: How strongly it was felt, on the Modified Mercalli scale, e.g. 'IV/V'.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

magnitude.description: Its magnitude; null while IPMA hasn't worked it out.

magnitude_type.description: How the magnitude was measured, e.g. 'Local magnitude (ML)'.

place.description: Where it was, as IPMA names it, e.g. 'NE Bragança' or 'W Faial'.

shakemap_url.description: IPMA's page mapping how it was felt, when there is one.

summary.description: One line with how many there were and the strongest.

total.description: How many earthquakes match in the last 30 days.

updated_at.description: When IPMA last updated its list (ISO 8601, UTC).

get_fire_risk.description: Get the rural fire risk forecast for mainland Portugal's municipalities for today, tomorrow or the day after, from low to maximum, the highest first.
get_fire_risk.display_str_template: Get the fire risk forecast for {0}.

mock_response.summary: Fire risk for 7 municipalities on 2026-11-02; the highest is Very high in 7 of them.

get_fire_risk.name: get_fire_risk

parameters.description: Which day's forecast: today, tomorrow or the day after. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: Only municipalities in this district. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: district

parameters.description: Only these municipalities. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: municipalities

options.label: Vila Nova de Cerveira (Viana do Castelo)

parameters.description: Only municipalities at this risk or higher. Leave blank for every risk.
parameters.name: minimum_risk

date.description: The day the forecast is for (YYYY-MM-DD).

model_run_date.description: The day of the forecast run it comes from (YYYY-MM-DD).

municipalities.description: Each mainland municipality's fire risk, the highest first.

district.description: The district it is in, e.g. 'Lisboa'.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

risk.description: The risk in words: Low, Moderate, High, Very high or Maximum.

summary.description: One line with the day and the highest risk.

updated_at.description: When IPMA last updated this forecast (ISO 8601, UTC).

get_forecast_for_day.description: Get one day's weather forecast for every place IPMA forecasts for (today, tomorrow or the day after), optionally only in one region: the weather in words, temperatures, rain and wind.
get_forecast_for_day.display_str_template: Get the forecast for every location for {0}.

mock_response.summary: Forecast for 4 locations on 2026-11-03; the warmest is Funchal at 23 °C.

get_forecast_for_day.name: get_forecast_for_day

parameters.description: Which day's forecast: today, tomorrow or the day after. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: Only mainland Portugal, Madeira or the Azores. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: region

date.description: The day the forecast is for (YYYY-MM-DD).

locations.description: The forecast for each place, by name.

location_id.description: IPMA's id for the place, e.g. '1110600' for Lisboa.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

rain_intensity.description: How heavy the rain will be: No rain, Light, Moderate or Heavy. Null when IPMA doesn't say.

rain_probability_percent.description: The chance of rain, from 0 to 100.

weather.description: The weather expected, in words, e.g. 'Partly cloudy'.

wind_direction.description: Where the wind mostly comes from: N, NE, E and so on.

wind_direction_name.description: The wind direction in words, e.g. 'Northwest'.

wind_strength.description: How strong the wind will be: Light, Moderate, Strong or Very strong.

region.description: The region asked for, or null for all three.

summary.description: One line with the day, how many places and the warmest.

updated_at.description: When IPMA last updated this forecast (ISO 8601, UTC).

get_latest_observations.description: Get the latest hourly reading of IPMA's weather stations: temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, rain and sunshine, for the stations you choose or every station in a region.
get_latest_observations.display_str_template: Get the latest IPMA station observations.

mock_response.summary: Latest readings of 2 stations, the newest at 2026-11-02T17:00:00Z.

get_latest_observations.name: get_latest_observations

parameters.description: The weather stations to read, from the list or by name or id. Leave blank for every station.
parameters.name: stations

parameters.description: Only mainland Portugal, Madeira or the Azores. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: region

observations.description: Each station's latest reading, by station name. A value a station doesn't measure is null.

humidity_percent.description: Relative humidity, the hour's average, in %.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

observed_at.description: The hour of the reading (ISO 8601, UTC).

pressure_hpa.description: Air pressure at sea level, the hour's average, in hPa.

rain_mm.description: Rain that fell in the hour, in mm.

solar_radiation_kj_m2.description: Sunshine energy in the hour, in kJ/m².

station_id.description: IPMA's id for the weather station, e.g. '1200535'.

temperature_c.description: Air temperature, the hour's average, in °C.

wind_direction.description: Where the wind came from: N, NE, E and so on.

wind_direction_name.description: The wind direction in words, or 'Calm'.

wind_speed_kmh.description: Wind speed at 10 metres, in km/h.

wind_speed_ms.description: Wind speed at 10 metres, in metres a second.

observed_at.description: The newest hour among the readings (ISO 8601, UTC).

stations_without_readings.description: Stations asked for that sent nothing in the last three hours.

summary.description: One line saying what was found.

get_sea_forecast.description: Get the sea forecast for the coast of mainland Portugal, Madeira and the Azores for today, tomorrow or the day after: wave and swell height, swell period, wave direction and sea temperature.

mock_response.summary: Sea forecast for 3 coastal locations on 2026-11-02; the highest waves, up to 1.5 m, at Lisboa, costa.

get_sea_forecast.name: get_sea_forecast

parameters.description: Which day's forecast: today, tomorrow or the day after. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: Only these stretches of coast. Leave blank for all of them.
parameters.name: coastal_locations

date.description: The day the forecast is for (YYYY-MM-DD).

locations.description: The sea forecast for each coastal place, by name.

location_id.description: IPMA's id for the place, e.g. '1110600' for Lisboa.

location_name.description: The coastal place's name, e.g. 'Lisboa, costa'.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative is west).

sea_temperature_max_c.description: The highest sea surface temperature, in °C.

sea_temperature_min_c.description: The lowest sea surface temperature, in °C.

swell_height_max_m.description: The highest height of the swell, in metres.

swell_height_min_m.description: The lowest height of the swell, in metres.

swell_period_max_s.description: The longest time between swell waves, in seconds.

swell_period_min_s.description: The shortest time between swell waves, in seconds.

wave_direction.description: Where the waves mostly come from: N, NE and so on.

wave_height_max_m.description: The highest height of the waves (significant wave height), in metres.

wave_height_min_m.description: The lowest height of the waves (significant wave height), in metres.

summary.description: One line with the day and where the waves are highest.

updated_at.description: When IPMA last updated this forecast (ISO 8601, UTC).

parameters.name: hours

pressure_hpa.description: Air pressure at sea level, the hour's average, in hPa.

rain_mm.description: Rain that fell in the hour, in mm.

solar_radiation_kj_m2.description: Sunshine energy in the hour, in kJ/m².

temperature_c.description: Air temperature, the hour's average, in °C.

wind_direction.description: Where the wind came from: N, NE, E and so on.

wind_direction_name.description: The wind direction in words, or 'Calm'.

wind_speed_kmh.description: Wind speed at 10 metres, in km/h.

wind_speed_ms.description: Wind speed at 10 metres, in metres a second.

station_id.description: IPMA's id for the weather station, e.g. '1200535'.

summary.description: One line with the station and its latest reading.

get_warnings.description: Get IPMA's weather warnings for the next three days: for each district or island area, what the warning is for (wind, rain, heat and so on), its level (yellow, orange or red), when it starts and ends, and IPMA's description in Portuguese.

mock_response.summary: No yellow, orange or red warnings in the next three days; 2 listed as green (no warning).

get_warnings.name: get_warnings

parameters.description: Only warnings for these districts or island areas. Leave blank for every area.
parameters.name: areas

parameters.description: The least serious warnings to list. Defaults to yellow, orange and red; green lists every area and type, including those with no warning.
parameters.name: minimum_level

options.label: Every area and type, green (no warning) too

parameters.description: Only warnings for these kinds of weather. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: warning_types

minimum_level.description: The lowest level listed: green, yellow, orange or red.

summary.description: One line with how many warnings there are of each level.

warnings.description: The warnings for the next three days, the most serious first.

area_name.description: The warning area, e.g. 'Lisboa' or 'Madeira, south coast'.

description.description: IPMA's description of what to expect, in Portuguese. Only yellow, orange and red warnings have one.

level.description: How serious: yellow, orange or red; green means no warning.

type.description: What the warning is for: Thunderstorm, Rough seas, Rain, Wind, Snow, Low temperature, High temperature or Fog.

warning_id.description: An id for the warning made of its area, type, level and start, e.g. 'LSB-wind-yellow-2026-11-03T06:00:00Z'.

list_locations.description: List the places IPMA forecasts for: the district capitals, the island towns of Madeira and the Azores and a few others, each with its id, district, municipality and weather warning area.

description: Get Portugal's official weather from IPMA, the national weather and sea institute: 5-day forecasts, weather warnings, live readings from weather stations, sea, UV and fire risk forecasts, and recent earthquakes, for mainland Portugal, Madeira and the Azores. No account or API key required.

ipma_new_earthquake_trigger.description: Triggers once for each earthquake IPMA records in mainland Portugal, Madeira or the Azores, optionally only from a lowest magnitude. IPMA lists earthquakes minutes to an hour after they happen. Earthquakes already listed when you turn it on never trigger it

parameters.description: Only earthquakes in mainland Portugal, Madeira or the Azores. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: area

parameters.description: Only earthquakes of at least this magnitude, e.g. 3. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: minimum_magnitude

ipma_new_weather_warning_trigger.description: Triggers once for each yellow, orange or red weather warning IPMA issues for Portugal, optionally only for one area and from a lowest level. A warning raised to a higher level triggers it again. Warnings already issued when you turn it on never trigger it

parameters.description: Only warnings for this district or island area, e.g. Lisboa. Leave blank for every area.
parameters.name: area

parameters.description: Only warnings of this level or higher: yellow, orange or red. Defaults to yellow.
parameters.name: minimum_level
